settings.heading: How does the HD Wireless Ear Wax Removal Camera work?
settings.row_content: Simply connect the device to your smartphone via WiFi, insert it gently into your ear, and use the real-time HD camera view to safely remove wax.

settings.heading: Is it safe to use for kids and seniors?
settings.row_content: Yes! The device is designed with soft silicone tips and a 3.5mm ultra-thin camera, making it safe for all ages, including kids and seniors.

settings.heading: How do I charge the device?
settings.row_content: It comes with a USB rechargeable battery that lasts multiple uses on a single charge. Just plug it into any USB port for quick charging.

settings.heading: Can I use this for more than just ear cleaning?
settings.row_content: Absolutely! The HD camera is perfect for checking your nose, scalp, teeth, and even your pet’s ears, making it a multi-purpose hygiene tool.
